_comment: Exact versions of the libraries a React preview may import. build.mjs installs them into a scratch folder, bundles them into ../vendor and records each file's sha256 in ../vendor/manifest.json. Not a package manifest on purpose: these are browser code the box serves, not dependencies of the server. tarballs are packages not on npm: fetched at build time and checked against a sha256 before they are installed.

xlsx.why: the npm package xlsx stopped at 0.18.5 with known vulnerabilities; SheetJS publishes current releases only from its own CDN. It is fetched at build time, checked against this hash, and served from the box
